notes.title: Dev Log #13
notes.notes:
Major Gameplay Changes: 

Bare-Bone Base-Building System Core Features:
Four buildings can currently be built: 'Hunter Temp', 'Gatherer Temp', 'Woodcutter Spot', 'Crafter Spot'.

Raids:
Raids will spawn at set intervals.

Warpoints:
Warpoints can be earned by defeating enemies and used to gain random rewards such as new units, relics, or equipment.

Crafting Systems:
Weapons will now wear out and break. AI will automatically find a replacement of the same type.
Winning Condition:

Currently, there is no winning condition.
